notes: Crystal rule. COILED. Gesture: the coil tucks back, then UNROLLS and flicks its tip at the foe, holds, and rolls back up; the coil is one stroke whose spiral curvature is scaled down, so it truly unfurls. Blue-green dark, fern-green light, white rims on the lit edges. Sport: painted fern (Athyrium niponicum var. pictum), silver fronds shaded burgundy.
